reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed urban landscapes over the past decade. As companies embrace flexible working arrangements, fewer employees commute to city centers daily, reducing traffic congestion and pollution. This shift has prompted a reevaluation of commercial real estate, with many downtown office buildings being converted into residential apartments or mixed-use developments. Consequently, some cities have experienced revitalization in previously neglected areas, while others face economic challenges as tax revenue from commercial properties declines. Urban planners now must balance sustainability benefits with the need to maintain vibrant city economies.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one consequence of remote work adoption?
options: Conversion of office buildings to residential spaces
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '많은 다운타운 사무실 건물이 주거용 아파트나 복합용도 개발로 전환되고 있다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Remote work eliminates all urban problems
Remote work has both positive and negative effects on city development
Commercial real estate is becoming obsolete
questions.explanation: 본문은 원격근무의 긍정적 영향(교통 감소, 오염 감소)과 부정적 영향(세수 감소, 경제적 어려움)을 모두 언급하므로 균형잡힌 관점을 제시합니다.

questions.q: Based on the passage, urban planners face which challenge?
options: Balancing sustainability benefits with economic concerns
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 '도시 계획가들은 지속가능성 이점과 활발한 도시 경제 유지의 필요성을 균형잡아야 한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that remote work has improved the quality of life for most workers?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표명으로 시작하세요. 'I agree/disagree that...'로 시작하여 당신의 주요 주장을 간단히 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 원격근무의 주요 이점(또는 단점)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다. 예: 시간 절약, 유연성, 스트레스 감소 등
structure.body2: 두 번째 관점을 추가하거나 반대 주장에 대한 반박을 제시합니다. 예: 사회적 고립, 일과 삶의 경계 모호함 등
structure.conclusion: 주요 주장을 요약하고 최종 입장을 재확인합니다. 더 넓은 함의나 미래 전망으로 마무리합니다.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work has significantly improved...
Moreover, employees can now manage their time more efficiently...
However, some argue that remote work leads to...
To conclude, the benefits of remote work outweigh its drawbacks...
Furthermore, companies have reported increased productivity...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in traditional office environments. Others prefer remote work arrangements. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer remote work because...
One reason is that I can save time on commuting...
Another important advantage is that I have better work-life balance...
I believe remote work allows me to...
From my perspective, the flexibility of remote work...
sample_points: 통근 시간 절약과 더 많은 개인 시간 확보로 인한 삶의 질 향상
자신의 페이스대로 작업할 수 있고 방해 요소가 적어 생산성 증대

listening.title: Career Counseling Session
listening.script: Student: Professor Chen, I'm considering whether to pursue a career in environmental science or computer engineering. Both fields interest me, but I'm worried about job prospects. Professor: That's a thoughtful concern. Both fields have excellent opportunities, but in different ways. Environmental science is growing as companies focus on sustainability, but positions can be competitive. Computer engineering offers more immediate job availability and higher starting salaries. However, the field requires continuous learning to stay current. Student: What about personal fulfillment? Professor: Excellent question. Environmental science offers direct impact on planetary health, which many find deeply fulfilling. Computer engineering offers problem-solving challenges and innovation. I'd suggest interning in both fields to experience them firsthand. Your passion matters as much as job prospects. Student: That's really helpful advice. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the student's primary concern?
options: Choosing between two career paths and considering job prospects
questions.explanation: 학생이 환경과학과 컴퓨터공학 중 선택하면서 '취업 전망'을 걱정한다고 명시적으로 언급합니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what advantage does computer engineering have over environmental science?
options: More immediate job availability and higher starting salaries
questions.explanation: 교수는 컴퓨터공학이 '더 많은 즉시적인 일자리 기회와 더 높은 초봉'을 제공한다고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What does the professor recommend the student do?
options: Intern in both fields to experience them firsthand
Ignore job prospects and follow passion
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생이 두 분야 모두에서 인턴십을 통해 직접 경험하기를 제안합니다.
